name: llm-bench-multilingual-hints-v1
description:
LLM Bench v2.1 (Multilingual GSM8K with Hints and Choices)
	

This dataset extends the multilingual GSM8K benchmark with:

Hints (hints_en, hints_ru, hints_kk)
Multiple-choice answer options (options_lang)
Consistent correct_index across languages

Languages: English 🇬🇧, Russian 🇷🇺, Kazakh 🇰🇿Maintained by diadvice.
reputation: A community-maintained multilingual extension of GSM8K (by diadvice) used for multilingual math reasoning evaluation with hints and multiple-choice options.
